description: Apple design foundation — the shared layer every page consumes. Create the iOS ToggleSwitch and rewrite globals.css to the Apple palette + font stack, then restyle the shadcn primitives (button, input, card, badge, tabs, select, table, dialog) and fix the root font application in app/layout.tsx. No page/component files are touched in this FEAT. After this FEAT the project builds and all tokens are Apple; pages still carry green classes until their own FEAT runs (buildable, visually transitional).
steps: Create components/ui/toggle-switch.tsx: 'use client'; props ToggleSwitch({ checked, onChange, disabled?, size='md', color='blue' }) with onChange:(v:boolean)=>void; import cn from '@/lib/utils'; render <button type='button' role='switch' aria-checked={checked} onClick={()=>!disabled&&onChange(!checked)} className={cn(track classes, disabled classes)}> with a <span> knob. Track: rounded-full transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out; off bg #E5E5EA; on bg = blue #007AFF | green #34C759 | orange #FF9500 (switch on color). Knob: bg-white rounded-full shadow-sm transition-all duration-200. md: track w-[51px] h-[31px], knob w-[27px] h-[27px], translate-x-[2px] off / translate-x-[22px] on. sm: track w-[38px] h-[22px], knob w-[18px] h-[18px], translate-x-[2px] off / translate-x-[18px] on. disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed. Export both default and named ToggleSwitch.

Rewrite app/globals.css :root to the Apple palette exactly: --background 240 5% 96%; --foreground 0 0% 11%; --card 0 0% 100%; --card-foreground 0 0% 11%; --popover 0 0% 100%; --popover-foreground 0 0% 11%; --primary 211 100% 50%; --primary-foreground 0 0% 100%; --secondary 240 5% 96%; --secondary-foreground 0 0% 11%; --muted 240 5% 94%; --muted-foreground 240 4% 54%; --accent 240 5% 94%; --accent-foreground 0 0% 11%; --destructive 4 90% 58%; --destructive-foreground  0 0% 100%; --border 240 6% 90%; --input 240 6% 90%; --ring 211 100% 50%; --radius 0.75rem. Remove the .dark block. In the base body rule set: font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, var(--font-inter), 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; font-size: 14px; and keep bg-background text-foreground. Add ::-webkit-scrollbar { width:6px; height:6px } ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background:transparent } ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background:#C7C7CC; border-radius:3px } ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background:#8E8E93 }.

Update app/layout.tsx: change <body className={inter.className}> to <body className={inter.variable}> so --font-inter is defined (not forced) and the globals.css font stack with -apple-system leading actually applies. Keep the Inter import and metadata.

Update components/ui/button.tsx buttonVariants base: 'inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-xl text-sm font-medium ring-offset-background transition-all duration-150 active:scale-[0.97] focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0'. default: bg-[#007AFF] text-white hover:bg-[#0071EB]. destructive: bg-[#FF3B30] text-white hover:bg-[#E0352B]. outline: border border-[#E5E5EA] bg-white text-[#1C1C1E] hover:bg-[#F2F2F7]. secondary: bg-[#F2F2F7] text-[#1C1C1E] hover:bg-[#E5E5EA]. ghost: text-[#007AFF] hover:bg-[#F2F2F7]. link: text-[#007AFF] underline-offset-4 hover:underline. sizes: default 'h-[44px] px-5', sm 'h-9 px-4', lg 'h-[50px] px-7', keep icon 'h-10 w-10'.

Update components/ui/input.tsx to: 'flex h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[#E5E5EA] bg-white px-3 py-2 text-base text-[#1C1C1E] ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-[#C7C7CC] focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#007AFF] focus-visible:ring-offset-0 focus-visible:border-[#007AFF] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 md:text-sm'.

Update components/ui/card.tsx Card base className to: 'rounded-2xl border border-[#E5E5EA] bg-white text-card-foreground shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08),0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]'. Leave CardHeader/CardTitle/CardDescription/CardContent/CardFooter as-is.

Update components/ui/badge.tsx base to 'inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus:outline-none' (drop ring + font-semibold->font-medium). default: border-transparent bg-[#007AFF] text-white. secondary: border-transparent bg-[#F2F2F7] text-[#1C1C1E]. destructive: border-transparent bg-[#FF3B30]/10 text-[#FF3B30]. outline: border border-current bg-transparent text-foreground.

Update components/ui/tabs.tsx: TabsList className -> 'inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#F2F2F7] p-1 gap-1 text-muted-foreground' (remove h-10). TabsTrigger className -> 'inline-flex items-center justify-center whitespace-nowrap rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-[#8E8E93] ring-offset-background transition-all focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 data-[state=active]:bg-white data-[state=active]:text-[#1C1C1E] data-[state=active]:shadow-sm'.

Update components/ui/select.tsx: SelectTrigger -> 'flex h-11 w-full items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-[#E5E5EA] bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-[#1C1C1E] ring-offset-background data-[placeholder]:text-[#8E8E93] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#007AFF] focus:border-[#007AFF] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 [&>span]:line-clamp-1'. SelectContent -> add 'rounded-xl border-[#E5E5EA] shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)]' (replace rounded-md border bg-popover shadow-md). SelectItem -> replace 'rounded-sm' with 'rounded-lg' and 'focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground' with 'focus:bg-[#F2F2F7] focus:text-[#1C1C1E]'.

Update components/ui/table.tsx: TableRow hover class 'hover:bg-muted/50' -> 'hover:bg-[#F2F2F7]/50'. TableHead -> 'h-11 px-4 text-left align-middle text-xs uppercase tracking-wide font-medium text-[#8E8E93] [&:has([role=checkbox])]:pr-0'.

Update components/ui/dialog.tsx: DialogOverlay 'bg-black/80' -> 'bg-black/30'. DialogContent base: replace 'border bg-background ... shadow-lg ... sm:rounded-lg' with 'border border-[#E5E5EA] bg-background p-6 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)] ... sm:rounded-2xl'. Keep all animation classes.
acceptance_criteria: components/ui/toggle-switch.tsx exists, is 'use client', exports ToggleSwitch, compiles, and renders an iOS pill with a white knob that translates on/off for md and sm sizes.

app/globals.css :root contains the exact Apple palette tokens listed and the body uses the -apple-system-first font stack with var(--font-inter); the .dark block is gone; custom scrollbar styles are present.
app/layout.tsx applies inter.variable (not inter.className) so the system font leads.
button/input/card/badge/tabs/select/table/dialog primitives compile with the Apple classes and no longer reference green or the old palette defaults.
Running `npm run build` from the repo root passes with 0 TypeScript errors.
verification: Confirm the build finishes with 0 TypeScript/compile errors.
Confirm components/ui/toggle-switch.tsx compiles and is exported.
findings: Apple design foundation applied. Created components/ui/toggle-switch.tsx — a 'use client' iOS pill switch (md/sm sizes, blue/green/orange on-colors, white knob with translate on/off, disabled state). Rewrote app/globals.css :root to the exact Apple HSL palette (--primary 211 100% 50% #007AFF, --destructive 4 90% 58% #FF3B30, --border 240 6% 90% #E5E5EA, --radius 0.75rem, --background 240 5% 96% #F2F2F7) and removed the .dark block; body now uses the -apple-system-first font stack with var(--font-inter) so the system font leads, 14px base, antialiased, plus thin custom scrollbars. Updated app/layout.tsx: Inter config gains variable:'--font-inter' and <body> uses inter.variable instead of inter.className. Restyled all target shadcn primitives with Apple classes: button (rounded-xl, active:scale-[0.97], #007AFF/#FF3B30/#F2F2F7 variants, 44px default), input (h-11 rounded-xl border-[#E5E5EA] focus #007AFF), card (rounded-2xl + layered shadow), badge (font-medium, tinted destructive), tabs (rounded-xl pill list, white active trigger), select (rounded-xl trigger/content/items with #007AFF focus and soft shadow), table (header text-xs uppercase #8E8E93, row hover #F2F2F7/50), dialog (bg-black/30 overlay, rounded-2xl content with soft shadow). No page/feature component, service, validator, or model was touched — those belong to FEAT-002+. Note: logo requirement (next/image /logo.png in Sidebar/login/TopBar) belongs to FEAT-002/003 scope, not this FEAT. Verification: npm run build finished with 0 TypeScript errors (exit 0, 17 routes generated).
